Rajeev Kumar Email:singh.tk3131@gmail.com Phone Number :82100001685

Objective

Data professional with a strong passion for solving complex data problems at scale. Over 5+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Analysis, and Data Analytics, with a proven ability to interpret and

analyze data to drive impactful business solutions. Experienced in supporting product feature enhancements through data insights, leveraging data visualization and advanced analytical tools. Demonstrates a strong interest in large-scale applications and actively seeks opportunities to work on projects that adopt and implement emerging technologies.

Experience

WNS Global Services

01-2025 - 04-2026

Lead associate collibra developer (DG)

Led enterprise data governance and metadata management initiatives using Collibra Data

Intelligence Cloud, supporting cataloging, lineage, stewardship, and compliance.

Configured and managed Collibra Data Catalog to enable data discovery, transparency, and

trust for business and technical users.

Integrated SQL Server and relational databases with Collibra using built-in connectors and

REST APIs for automated metadata ingestion and synchronization.

Created and governed Collibra assets including databases, schemas, tables, columns, datasets,

reports, KPIs, reference data, and business terms.

Designed and managed Communities and Domains aligned with the enterprise data governance

operating model, including stewardship roles and RACI.

Built and maintained Business Glossary and Data Dictionary, ensuring standardized definitions

across business and technical teams.

Implemented Data Quality management with rules, checks, scorecards, issue workflows, and

dashboards to monitor and improve data health.

Enabled end-to-end lineage and impact analysis, catalog curation (classification, tagging, ownership, certification), regulatory compliance, and user adoption through training and documentation.

Implemented Edge connections to extract and integrate data from multiple data sources.

Edgerock Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd

03-2022 - 12-2024

Collibra Developer (Associate Data Governance)

Designed and managed Collibra Communities, Sub-Communities, and Domains aligned with

enterprise data governance structures. Created and governed Business and Technology Assets, establishing relationships across datasets, applications, systems, and processes to support lineage and impact analysis. Configured, tested, and maintained Collibra workflows (Retention, Sample, Obsolete) using Eclipse and BPMN. Supported metadata loading, automation, and integration using the Collibra Operating Model and REST APIs. Implemented reference data and hierarchy management, performed data validation and cleansing, and collaborated with Erwin for metadata modelling and governance alignment.

Edgerock Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd

08-2020 - 03-2022

Data Analyst

Acquired and integrated data from primary and secondary sources across multiple

user interfaces and databases.

Applied data analytics to optimize business processes and improve operational efficiency. Partnered with business and sales leaders to analyze data and deliver actionable

insights through reports and dashboards.

Analyzed end-to-end workflow data to identify pain points and recommend improvements

to enhance customer experience.

Owned end-to-end dashboarding, analytics, and reporting, collaborating with cross-

functional teams and handling client requirements.

Skills

SQL ETL Excel Python Power BI Business Analysis Data Analysis Data Cleaning

Collibra Tool Data Governance Agile Methodology

Jira Data Quality Management Groovy

Edge Connection

Education

RGPV Bhopal - M.P

2017

B.E.: Mechanical Engineering

Certification

Certification of Completion Data Governance Learning Path Certification of collibra solution architect
